description: The plot titled “Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3” shows sparsity ratio values across model layers for three conditions (before gate, after gate, and after average gate). The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans layers 0 to 23 with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” uses a linear scale, and shows values from 0.0 up to 0.8 with labeled ticks every 0.2. A blue dashed line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003” stays very close to zero across all layers, starting near ~0.01 at layer 0 and approaching ~0.00 by the final layers. An orange dotted line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126” starts high near ~0.85 at layer 0, drops steeply over early layers (around ~0.40 by layer 2 and ~0.15 by about layer 5), continues decreasing to around ~0.03–0.05 by roughly layers 10–12, then remains low with small fluctuations, including a visible bump around layers ~20–22 (rising to roughly ~0.06–0.08) before ending near ~0.04–0.05 at layer 23. A green dash-dot line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080” also begins high near ~0.80 at layer 0, decreases sharply to roughly ~0.25–0.30 by layer 1 and ~0.10 by about layer 4–5, then tapers down further to around ~0.02 by about layer 10 and stays near ~0.00–0.01 through the final layers.
caption_used: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-3 across various layers. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer,' and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'Sparsity Ratio,' and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, starts at a ratio of approximately 0.0 at layer 0 and remains constant throughout. The green dash-dot line, representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, begins at about 0.8 at layer 0 and decreases exponentially, reaching 0.05 at layer 5 and stabilizing near 0.0 from layer 10 onward. The orange dotted line, representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, shows a similar pattern to the green line, beginning at about 0.8 at layer 0 and decreasing to around 0.2 by layer 10, with a small spike after layer 20. Notably, the sparsity ratio after the average gate consistently exceeds the sparsity ratio after the gate across all layers.
